architecture.title: Two Ollamas on one Spark — the systemd service and the one inside Open WebUI
architecture.caption: The Ollama you install with the playbook's script runs as a systemd service on 127.0.0.1:11434 and speaks two APIs: native /api/* and OpenAI-compatible /v1/*. Your laptop reaches it through an ssh -L tunnel (local port 21434). The Open WebUI container (ghcr.io/open-webui/open-webui:ollama) bundles a second Ollama with its own model volume; only the web app is published, on host port 12000.

sequence.title: Lab 03-4 — one tool-calling round trip through /v1/chat/completions
sequence.caption: The model never runs code. It answers the first request with tool_calls (here two in parallel); the lab runs sparkkit's weights_gb and decode_ceiling_tok_s locally and sends each result back as a role=tool message; the second request returns the final text. Sequence captured with nemotron-3-nano on the laptop stand-in.
